scientific_integrity: General convexity, Kirchhoff-index derivatives, and the original tree allocation are prior results. The assessed contribution consists of the closed cut-correlation threshold for arbitrary priced trees, price-locality, sharp bounds, and exact finite-size two-hop extremizers. Finite exact checks corroborate but cannot certify universal assertions. No independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: One optional edge, a shared linear conductance budget, and the sum of all pairwise effective resistances. The link-activation threshold is exact, but conductances below threshold are not explicitly classified. An equivalent historical specialized theorem has not been conclusively ruled out. The primary source has an earlier month-only conference version, so the stated source date is the earliest independently day-verified public date used.
title: Price-locality and sharp two-hop purchase windows for optimally weighted trees
